melody.midnightconfig.title: Melody Config
melody.midnightconfig.reloadWarning: Most config options will require a game restart to take affect!
melody.midnightconfig.accessibleCreepers: Master toggle for all creeper-related accessibility features
melody.midnightconfig.creeperIgnitionReq: Creepers will only ignite when a player is looking at them
melody.midnightconfig.creepersPreserveCo: Creepers will not be able to destroy blocks with inventories
melody.midnightconfig.creeperDefuseDista: The distance away from the creeper a player needs to be for it to defuse
melody.midnightconfig.creeperExplosionPo: The radius of the creeper explosion
melody.midnightconfig.creeperEntityDamag: How much entity explosion damage should scale based on the explosion power
melody.midnightconfig.vehiclesMoveThroug: Rideable mobs can move through leaves when ridden
melody.midnightconfig.leafSpeedFactor: Rideable mob speed percentage while inside leaves
